Jodhpur Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd New Power House, Industrial Area, Jodhpur-342003 Govt. of Jammu and Kashmir, Civil Secretariat, Jammu-180001 **Respondents** # **Parties present:** Ms. Anushree Bardhan, Advocate, THDC Shri Mukesh Kumar Verma, THDC Shri Varun Shankar, Advocate, TPDDL Shri Abhishek Advocate, TPDDL # ** INTERIM ORDER ** The Petitioner, THDC India Ltd. has filed this Review Petition against the Commission's order dated 9.10.2018 in Petition No. 117/GT/2018, wherein the Commission had determined the tariff of Koteshwar Hydroelectric Power Project (4 x 100 MW) for the period from 1.4.2014 (COD of Unit -I) to 31.3.2019 in terms of the CERC (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2014. 2. Aggrieved by the said order dated 9.10.2018, the Petitioner has sought review on the ground that there are errors apparent on the face of record on the **____________________________________________________________________________ Interim order in P.No. 47/RP/2018 in P. No. 117/GT/2018 Page 2 of 3** following: - _(i) Non-consideration of additional capital expenditure funded through internal resources of the company towards the equity component._ - _(ii) Non-consideration of the actual income tax rate while computing the return of equity component._ 3. Heard the learned counsel for the Petitioner. Admit. Issue notice to respondents. 4. The Petitioner is directed to serve copy of the Review Petition along with this order on the Respondents by 4.2.2019. The Respondents shall file their replies by 14.2.2019, with advance copy to the Petitioner, who shall file its rejoinder, if any, by 28.2.2019. The parties shall ensure the completion of pleadings within the dates mentioned above. 5. Matter shall be listed for hearing in due course for which separate notice shall be issue to the parties.
